{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 541,
      "where": "Direct images throughout this page and the diagrams on p. 542",
      "scan": "f_{\\ast} and R^{1}f_{\\ast}, without a bar on f",
      "tex": "\\bar{f}_{\\ast} and R^{1}\\bar{f}_{\\ast}",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$\\bar{f}_{\\ast}\\GG_{m}(\\mathfrak{m})$ dans",
        "new": "$f_{\\ast}\\GG_{m}(\\mathfrak{m})$ dans"
      },
      "note": "Systematic notational difference, reported once. This edit fixes a sample occurrence; the coordinator gives three examples and the remaining scope."
    },
    {
      "page": 541,
      "where": "Proposition 1.5.14, identification of the inverse functors",
      "scan": "les foncteurs e et j",
      "tex": "les foncteurs $e$ et\n$j$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "les foncteurs $e$ et $j^{\\ast}$",
      "note": "The inverse functor defined immediately above is j^{\\ast}, not the map j. The TeX keeps the printed omission of the asterisk."
    },
    {
      "page": 541,
      "where": "1.5.15, the line bundle preceding the final displayed isomorphism",
      "scan": "faisceau inversible sur X_2",
      "tex": "faisceau inversible sur $\\bar{X}_{2}$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "faisceau inversible sur $\\bar{X}_{2}$",
      "note": "The line bundle with modulus must be on the compactification. The TeX silently corrects the missing bar."
    },
    {
      "page": 541,
      "where": "1.5.15, hypothesis on the line bundle",
      "scan": "pour ℒ faisceau inversible sur X_2 et K torseur sur X_1",
      "tex": "rigidifié le long de $Y_2$",
      "kind": "extra",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": " rigidifié le long de $Y_2$",
        "new": ""
      },
      "note": "The printed sentence contains no rigidification clause."
    },
    {
      "page": 542,
      "where": "The four left-hand vertices of diagrams (1.5.15.1) and (1.5.15.2)",
      "scan": "\\GG_m(\\mathfrak{m}), with no index on the modulus",
      "tex": "\\GG_m(\\mathfrak{m}_1) or \\GG_m(\\mathfrak{m}_2)",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\Ext^{1}(R^1\\bar{f}_{1\\ast} \\GG_m (\\mathfrak{m}_1), G)",
        "new": "\\Ext^{1}(R^1\\bar{f}_{1\\ast} \\GG_m (\\mathfrak{m}), G)"
      },
      "note": "The edition systematically adds modulus indices in these diagrams. This sample edit is to be extended to all four vertices, as specified in the coordinator."
    },
    {
      "page": 542,
      "where": "Diagram (1.5.15.1), label of the left vertical arrow",
      "scan": "\\Ext^{1}(u^{\\ast},\\Id)",
      "tex": "\\Ext^{1}(\\bar{u}^{\\ast},\\Id)",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\Ext^{1}(\\bar{u}^{\\ast},\\Id)",
        "new": "\\Ext^{1}(u^{\\ast},\\Id)"
      },
      "note": "The printed arrow label has no bar on u."
    },
    {
      "page": 542,
      "where": "Hypothesis preceding the norm isomorphism",
      "scan": "Y_{1}\\supset\\bar{u}^{-1}Y_{2}",
      "tex": "Y_{1}=\\bar{u}^{-1}Y_{2}",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "Y_{1}=\\bar{u}^{-1}Y_{2}",
        "new": "Y_{1}\\supset\\bar{u}^{-1}Y_{2}"
      },
      "note": "Both scans show a containment sign, not equality. The TeX strengthens the printed hypothesis."
    },
    {
      "page": 542,
      "where": "The line bundle in the hypothesis preceding the norm isomorphism",
      "scan": "faisceau inversible sur X_1",
      "tex": "faisceau inversible sur $X_{1}$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "faisceau inversible sur $\\bar{X}_{1}$",
      "note": "The line bundle to which the displayed norm applies must be on the compactification. The TeX keeps the printed missing bar."
    },
    {
      "page": 542,
      "where": "Hypothesis on the line bundle preceding the norm isomorphism",
      "scan": "sur X_1 et K torseur sur X_2",
      "tex": "rigidifié le long de $Y_1$",
      "kind": "extra",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": " rigidifié le long de $Y_1$",
        "new": ""
      },
      "note": "This rigidification clause is absent from the print."
    },
    {
      "page": 542,
      "where": "Diagram (1.5.15.2), label of the left vertical arrow",
      "scan": "\\Ext^{1}(N_{X_1/X_2},\\Id)",
      "tex": "\\Ext^{1}(N_{\\bar{X}_1 /\\bar{X}_2}, \\Id)",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\Ext^{1}(N_{\\bar{X}_1 /\\bar{X}_2}, \\Id)",
        "new": "\\Ext^{1}(N_{X_1 /X_2}, \\Id)"
      },
      "note": "Unlike the norm in the preceding displayed isomorphism, the printed diagram label has no bars on either X."
    },
    {
      "page": 543,
      "where": "1.6.2, after the first representability assertion ending « localement de type fini »",
      "scan": "The assertion ends with a period and is followed directly by « Si P est un groupe algébrique… »; there is no footnote.",
      "tex": "\\acorriger{Dans le cas où ... un schéma en groupe lisse.}",
      "kind": "extra",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\acorriger{Dans le cas où $G'_1=G'_2=0$, c'est évident. Dans le\ncas où $G''_1=G''_2=0$, en utilisant \\SGA 3 V 10.1.1 (nouvelle édition),\non peut se ramener au cas où $G'_1\\to G'_2$ est un\nmonomorphisme, qui est traité dans (\\SGA 3 VI${}_{\\text{A}}$ 3.2).\nOn est ainsi ramené au cas où $G'_1=G''_1=0$. On peut alors considérer le\nfaisceau $G$ comme un torseur sous $G'_2$ au-dessus du schéma $G''_2$. Si\non suppose que $G'_2$ est affine (situation dans laquelle on se retrouve\nd'après (\\SGA 3 VI${}_{\\text{B}}$ 11.17) si avant de faire des réductions\non a supposé $G'_1$ et $G'_2$ affines), alors la représentabilité de $G$\nrésulte aussitôt de la descente fidèlement plate. Ce cas particulier est\nsuffisant pour les utilisations faites dans ce paragraphe. Si $G'_2$ est\nquasi-projectif, on peut obtenir la représentabilité de $G$ en utilisant\n(\\SGA 1 VIII 7.7) et des arguments semblables à\nceux de \\cite[Lemme~3.3.1]{SGA4-18:4bis}. En fait, tout schéma en groupes $G$\nde type fini sur un corps est quasi-projectif : on peut supposer que $G$\nest connexe, c'est alors \\cite[Corollary~1.2]{SGA4-18:0bis} si $G$ est lisse et (M.\nRaynaud) le cas général s'y ramène parce que d'après (\\SGA 3\nVII${}_{\\text{A}}$ 8.3) il existe\nun morphisme fini de $G$ vers un schéma en groupe lisse.}",
        "new": ""
      },
      "note": "The entire additional discussion in this \\acorriger block is absent from the printed page."
    },
    {
      "page": 544,
      "where": "Paragraph immediately after (1.6.3.1), second direct image",
      "scan": "p_{\\ast}\\GG_{m_Y}",
      "tex": "(pi)_{\\ast}\\GG_{m_Y}",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$(pi)_{\\ast}\\GG_{m_{Y}}$ sont",
        "new": "$p_{\\ast}\\GG_{m_{Y}}$ sont"
      },
      "note": "The printed prose uses p_{\\ast} for this second direct image, whereas the TeX writes the composite explicitly."
    },
    {
      "page": 544,
      "where": "Reference supporting connectedness of the first representing group",
      "scan": "(1.3.13.1)",
      "tex": "\\eqhyperref[XVIII.par1.5.13.1]{1.5.13.1}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\eqhyperref[XVIII.par1.5.13.1]{1.5.13.1}",
      "note": "The print gives the wrong reference number. The TeX silently corrects it to (1.5.13.1)."
    },
    {
      "page": 544,
      "where": "Paragraph after Definition 1.6.4, « engendré par le… »",
      "scan": "le préfaisceaux",
      "tex": "le préfaisceau",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "le préfaisceau",
      "note": "The printed plural ending is a typing error after « le ». The TeX silently corrects it."
    },
    {
      "page": 544,
      "where": "Paragraph after Definition 1.6.4, argument of the presheaf",
      "scan": "à chaque section S sur k",
      "tex": "à chaque schéma $S$ sur $k$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "à chaque schéma $S$ sur $k$",
      "note": "Here S is a k-scheme, not a section. The TeX silently corrects the printed word."
    },
    {
      "page": 544,
      "where": "Paragraph after Definition 1.6.4, the products supporting the modules and their trivializations",
      "scan": "S followed by a blank product-sign position with subscript k and then X; likewise before Y",
      "tex": "$\\fprod{S}{X}{k}$ and $\\fprod{S}{Y}{k}$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$\\fprod{S}{X}{k}$ et $\\fprod{S}{Y}{k}$",
      "note": "Both product signs are missing in the printed typescript; the same blank positions are visible in the witness. The TeX supplies the expected multiplication signs."
    },
    {
      "page": 544,
      "where": "Final paragraph, reference to the Kummer exact sequence",
      "scan": "La suite exacte de Kummer 1.4.1",
      "tex": "La suite exacte de Kummer \\hyperref[XVIII.lem1.6.1]{1.6.1}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\hyperref[XVIII.lem1.6.1]{1.6.1}",
      "note": "The relevant Kummer sequence is Lemma 1.6.1. The TeX silently corrects the printed reference 1.4.1."
    },
    {
      "page": 544,
      "where": "Formula (1.6.4.1), subscript of Pic",
      "scan": "{}_{n}\\sheafPic^{\\tau}_{\\mathfrak{m}_{X/k}}(k)",
      "tex": "{}_{n}\\sheafPic^{\\tau}_{\\mathfrak{m},X/k}(k)",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "{}_{n}\\sheafPic^{\\tau}_{\\mathfrak{m},X/k}(k)",
      "note": "The print omits the separating comma and puts X/k below m, unlike the notation defined above. The TeX silently restores the defined subscript."
    },
    {
      "page": 545,
      "where": "1.6.5, end of the opening hypotheses",
      "scan": "et G un groupe abélien fini tué par n",
      "tex": "et\n$G$ groupe abélien fini tué par $n$",
      "kind": "missing",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$G$ groupe abélien fini tué par $n$.",
        "new": "$G$ un groupe abélien fini tué par $n$."
      },
      "note": "The TeX omits « un »."
    },
    {
      "page": 545,
      "where": "1.6.5, beginning of the paragraph « Le groupe… »",
      "scan": "\\sheafPic_{\\mathfrak{m},X/k}",
      "tex": "\\sheafPic_{\\mathfrak{m},X/k}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\sheafPic_{\\mathfrak{m},\\bar{X}/k}",
      "note": "The modulus is on the compactification, as also shown by the neutral subgroup and all subsequent terms of the composed isomorphism. The TeX keeps the printed missing bar on this first X."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "541: 2/2; 542: 5/1; 543: 1/0; 544: 1/6; 545: 1/1 (normal/misprint).\nApply the p.542 modulus-index sample edit before extending the systematic f-bar replacement, since its old substring contains \\bar{f}.\nSystematic notation, pp.541–542: TeX adds a bar to f in 14 occurrences. Extend the sample edit throughout. Three examples: p.541 f_{\\ast}\\GG_m(\\mathfrak m) in the first paragraph; p.541 f_{\\ast}\\ch(G[1]) as the domain of e; p.542 R^1f_{1\\ast} in the upper-left vertex of (1.5.15.1).\nSystematic notation, p.542: remove the added index on \\mathfrak m in all four diagram vertices. Three examples: (1.5.15.1) upper-left \\mathfrak m_1, (1.5.15.1) lower-left \\mathfrak m_2, and (1.5.15.2) upper-left \\mathfrak m_2; all three print simply \\mathfrak m."
}
